doc.title: Crescent City Crystals: Dave Bailey, Harold Christophe, Albert Delone, Sylvester Handy Interview, 1963-11-13

chapter: Dave Bailey: early life and first bands
title: Bailey's orphan childhood and working out his age from his marriage
summary: Bailey never knew his parents, was raised by two old ladies, and married at about 18; the interviewer tries to work out his birth year.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: You see my mom and dad died like a baby. Uh-huh. And I never knew my mom and dad. There was two old ladies, you know, normal people, you know. And they were having my mother and father. I never even knew that my age, you know. How they did to find it when I got married for my first wife. I got married in 1910.
Yeah, see I must have been about, I must have been about 18 years old when I got married.
So that would have put you about, born about 18, let me think.
82? 92. 92. Yeah, that would have put you about 100 years old. No. Yeah. You, I guess would have been about 19, 1892 then, you might have been born if you were 18 when you were married.
